test_validate_url: test the validate_url function to resolve and validate a user-supplied URL against blocked IPs
create_safe_get: create a safe HTTP GET request with SSRF protection that validates each redirect hop
create_async_safe_get: create an async safe HTTP GET request with SSRF protection on every redirect hop
test_is_blocked_ip: test the _is_blocked_ip function to check if an IP address is in a blocked network
test_is_host_allowlisted: test the _is_host_allowlisted function to check if a host is in the admin-configured allowlist
